description: "Thomas Hart Benton's Remarks to the Senate on the Expunging Resolution by Benton" is a political speech delivered in the 19th century, specifically during the period surrounding President Andrew Jackson's administration. As an important historical account, the document reflects the contentious political atmosphere of the time, focusing on the expunging of a resolution that condemned President Jackson.
